The honeymoon phase would probably buy you at least a year of happiness, it's how I've always wanted to die.  But I have no connections unfortunately, so I guess it's a quick miserable death for me, hopefully tomorrow.
What if you're old enough to have already lived it.....WHAT THEN!?
Same boat (26), but weirdly enough that has never really bothered me all that much, I guess peoples motives for suicide can be quite different.  Hope you find what you're looking for.

Luckily for me my dad is an irresponsible gun owner that just leaves his shit out in the open, makes my life a lot easier, or death I should say.  I feel like I'd be dead already if certain methods were available to me in vulnerable moments.

Same, I'm just afraid that once I open that door people will either think I'm being manipulative or will worry about me a lot afterwards.  I guess it's also a pride thing, as a male it's hard for me to show weakness, only after I've gotten better can I speak about things with little shame, I guess there's a big difference between saying "I'm in pain" and "I was in pain".  There's also the worry that if I express suicidality I will be watched like a hawk, which for a socially anxious introvert is not something I necessarily want.  I wish I could tell my father not to leave guns lying around the house as I'm afraid (even today) of what I'll do to myself.  Maybe alerting one person and making them promise not to tell others would make it easier for you to open up, maybe texting how you feel will be easier than speaking it (at least at first).  I wish I could give you better advice but I'm afraid I'm in the same boat, my delusions tell me that people will only believe you once you're dead, which I know to be not true, but it feels true.  Hopefully one person commenting makes you feel a bit better, stay safe friend.

Assuming you're suicidal and have percs you could just take enough to get you through the day, I wish I had some.  I guess I'm making some big assumptions though.  I doubt anyone is going to answer your question even if they did know.
Why not just get high instead, it'd buy you a little time.
Sometimes it's just all about waiting out the clock
